user_query: My company is organizing a conference and we need assistance with event planning. Can you recommend a venue with multiple conference rooms and modern facilities? Additionally, provide us with a list of keynote speakers and their contact details. Finally, suggest some team-building activities for the attendees.

TaskList.description: Research and recommend venues that have multiple conference rooms and modern facilities.
Compile a list of potential keynote speakers relevant to the conference theme along with their contact details.
Suggest various team-building activities suitable for conference attendees.
